label: Weekend of Nov 13–15
note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings and move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink. Many rinks stream on LiveBarn.

summary: Ontario teams are the story of Day 1 at the Little Caesars Challenger Cup. Toronto Jr Canadiens are 2-0 (3-0 over Top Gun #11, 6-0 over Windy City), Chatham-Kent is 2-0 (4-1 Seacoast, 6-1 Chicago Fury), Huron-Perth beat NJ Colonials (#21) 4-1, and Upper Canada College beat Cleveland 4-1.
Fox Motors (now #29, 93.75) is 2-0, beating Boston Jr Eagles (#20) 4-1 and Seacoast (#24) 2-0. Windy City beat Biggby 3-1 before losing 6-0 to Toronto.

Little Caesars (#3, 97.63) went 2-0. Penguins Elite went 2-0, including a 7-5 win over Ohio, and Nashville went 2-0, edging Masters 3-2 and Ohio 4-3. Team Illinois went 2-0, but a smaller-than-expected 4-1 win over Cleveland (#72) dropped it to #6 (97.02).

Top Gun (#13 now) had a rough day: 0-2, losing 3-0 to Toronto Jr Canadiens and 5-3 to St. Louis Blues. NJ Colonials split, losing 4-1 to Huron-Perth and beating Upper Canada College 3-2. Chicago Mission (97.08) climbs to #4 without playing.

Cleveland Barons (#25, now #24, 94.04) went 2-0 in Dallas, beating Anaheim (#18) 6-4 and Dallas Stars (#20) 6-4.
